reforms.description: The Financial Loan and Investment Program was increased by 210 billion yen to support various sectors, including housing and transportation, in response to the economic downturn.
reforms.package_name: 1965 Financial Loan and Investment Program Expansion
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Increases public investment in key sectors, which can stimulate economic activity and support recovery from recession.
reforms.status_evidence: The Financial Loans and Investment Program was increased to provide additional support.
reforms.importance_rationale: The increase in funding is significant for addressing immediate economic challenges, though it builds on an existing program rather than creating a new framework.
reforms.source_quote: The Financial Loans and Investment Program was increased by 210 billion yen; 50 billion yen for housing, 30 billion yen for water supply and sewer systems, 20 billion yen for transportation, etc.
